messages:
alex: Heads up – customer reported they got charged twice when reconnecting a streaming session that also invoked a toolcall. billing shows 2x partial token charges. anyone seen this pattern before?

maria: Ah that's the case where the client retried with a truncated prompt and the router fell back mid-stream, right? :thinking_face:

jamal: Yep. Root cause looks like we create a provisional charge on stream start, then when the toolcall executes we tag tokens to the toolcall path. If a reconnect creates a second provisional session we end up with overlap.

alex: snippet from the trace:```
[2026-03-20T15:02:12Z] session_id=abc123 provisional_charge=120 tokens path=stream-router-A
[2026-03-20T15:02:13Z] toolcall_id=tc-77 attached_to=session_id=abc123 charged=40
[2026-03-20T15:02:14Z] reconnect session_id=abc123-2 provisional_charge=80 path=stream-router-B
[2026-03-20T15:02:16Z] toolcall_id=tc-77 attached_to=session_id=abc123 charged=40 (duplicate?)
```

sophie: ugh. So the same toolcall `tc-77` is being credited twice because the second session reconciliation doesn't dedupe against the first tool attachment.

ben: How often is this happening? rate?

jamal: Only seen on one customer so far, but repros with a small harness. It needs: streaming + mid-stream toolcall + client reconnect within 2s + router fallback across paths. Low frequency in prod but still present.

maria: For the console UX: ops saw two separate provisional charges on different routes which looked like two requests. Not obvious to customers why cost doubled. We should show provenance and dedupe status per provisional charge.

alex: Proposal: change provisional charge lifecycle to attach a stable provenance id derived from toolcall id when a toolcall happens, and on reconnects dedupe by provenance id before finalizing charges.

jamal: Implementation notes: provenance id could be `session_root || toolcall_uuid || request_fingerprint`. Need to make sure routers propagate toolcall_uuid in fallback headers. Also TTL for provisional should be extended slightly to allow late handoffs.

ben: Concern: will this increase memory/kv pressure if TTL extended for many ephemeral sessions?

jamal: We can make TTL tunable per plan; Dedicated customers could have longer grace window. For hosted, maybe 10s -> 30s by default.

ops-bot: @channel Incident created: INC-2026-042, tagged billing-team, priority P2. Link: https://rwinternal/incident/INC-2026-042

alex: Also need a dashboard card that surfaces "provisional charge dedupe failures" with example traces. Right now our billing dashboard groups prov charges by session id only and misses cross-session duplicates.

maria: UX idea: show a small explainer next to provisional line-items: "This charge may be provisional and can be merged with a subsequent session if deduplication criteria match." Could help reduce support tickets.

ben: Quick mitigation: when toolcall attaches, mark subsequent provisional starts with a `linked_toolcall:true` flag and don't finalize a second provisional charge if a live finalized charge for same toolcall exists in the last X seconds. That avoids heavier URL-wide dedupe.

jamal: Good short-term fix. I'll draft a small change to ledger finalizer. Leaving a TODO to audit cross-region router headers — fallback paths sometimes drop the toolcall UUID.

alex: Recording action items: 1) jamal to ship ledger dedupe guard (short-term) 2) maria to prototype console explainer and dedupe metrics card 3) ben to run load test for TTL bump memory impact 4) ops-bot created INC ticket.

sophie: FYI I opened a support thread with customer + offered credit while we patch. They appreciated quick response. :heart:

alex: Thanks all. jamal, ping here when you have a PR link and i'll prioritize review.

jamal: will do, aiming EOD tomorrow.

maria: I'll mock a simple console tooltip and add an analytics event so we can measure how often users click it.

ben: I'll run a small canary on devoted infra and share memory/cardinality numbers.

alex: Ok closing loop here for now. if anyone uncovers other dup patterns (e.g., truncated prefix + toolcall swap) drop notes in this thread.

sophie: noted, thanks! :thumbsup:
